column1: Yandy Diaz headlines today’s Beat The Streak picks, leading off at home with a strong recent hit rate and a favorable matchup against Trevor Rogers, who struggles against righties. Bobby Witt Jr. offers similar reliability near the top of the order and has hit safely in nearly three-quarters of his games. Luis Arraez also stands out with steady season-long contact and a slight park boost, while Jake McCarthy and Jacob Wilson round out the list as viable alternatives with platoon advantages.
